global_principles: Decrease entropy: fewer scattered systems, fewer duplicate tasks, clearer ownership.
Increase coherence: every task should trace back to an org, project, and life priority.
Protect relationships: never optimise work at the expense of critical family obligations.
Default to private and compliant AI: sensitive data (FCRA, financials, personal PII) stays in private systems; external LLMs see only summaries/redacted views.
Agents propose structure; humans approve structural changes.

avoid_fragmentation: Maintain a single Life-OS task system as the source of truth.
External tools like Motion or GitHub are mirrors, not primary truth.
deadline_rules: Family emergencies and hard health deadlines override all other domains.
FCRA / compliance deadlines in Vuplicity are treated as CRITICAL unless explicitly downgraded.
meeting_rules: Do not book work meetings that consistently collide with fixed family anchors without explicit override by James.
